spec2def(feclient.dll feclient.spec)

# feclient.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/feclient-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
add_cargo_module(feclient feclient-cargo feclient.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
